units.source_text: 我觉得它和沉睡在我周围的许多事物一样，以崭新的意义再现了。

en.t: I felt that, like so many things lying asleep around me, it had reappeared with an entirely new meaning.

units.source_text: 睿山山峰突兀，山麓却很开阔，无限地伸展，恰似一个主题的余韵，总是在空间旋荡。

en.t: The peak of Mount Hiei rose abruptly, yet its foothills opened out broadly and stretched away without end, like the lingering resonance of a theme, always reverberating through space.

units.source_text: 在低矮房顶绵延不断的远方，睿山的皱襞的阴影，只挡住山麓的皱壁部分，山腰则春意盎然、色彩浓淡有致，笼罩在一片暗蓝色中。

en.t: Far beyond the unbroken spread of low rooftops, the shadows of Mount Hiei's folds covered only the wrinkled parts of the foothills, while the mountainside was full of spring, its colors subtly graded, enveloped in a deep blue haze.

units.source_text: 只有这里，显得格外的近，格外的鲜明。

en.t: Only this place seemed especially near, especially vivid.
